_doc: Single Pearl script commands changed or dropped by the story generator (b2tools/pearl_story.py FileTr.translate, script_patches()): Pearl script file -> command address (hex) -> {'args': the command's new arguments (the same command, translated as usual), or 'drop': why it goes}; each with 'why'. Keep this short: Pearl's scripts are translated as they are otherwise.

89._why: The Underground Man (Eterna; notes/UNDERGROUND.md section 8, the lead 2026-10-26): digging and Spheres are not built, so after the first trip down his missions go on with the Secret Base (var 0x40B6 = 3; notes/SECRET_BASES.md): his next test, then decorating and Flags, each with Pearl's goods; the first mission's reward is three Underground Traps, which do not exist here.

0x171.why: mission 1 done (var 0x40B6 = 1): his Secret Base mission (0x02D3) instead of mission 2 (0x0237, digging)

0x208.drop: no Underground Traps (first of the mission-1 reward's three GiveUndergroundTrap calls)

0x22c.why: after the first trip down: line 29 in place of line 7 (what Traps are)

358._why: The Battle Tower (notes/BATTLE_ZONE.md, the lead 2026-11-01): no wireless Multi, so the Multi receptionist doesn't ask about a friend and goes on to a partner in the tower

0x85d.drop: Would you like to communicate with a friend?

0x305.drop: Black 2's party screen fades by itself (as HoennB2's tower)

0x31b.drop: Black 2's party screen reopens the field itself

0xfb4.drop: Black 2's records screen fades by itself (the four record machines' subroutine; plat-tower 2026-11-08); the three results machines show a message on the field (plat-records)

0xfc6.drop: Black 2's records screen reopens the field itself (a second FieldOpen loads overlay 35 again: An error has occurred); the results message never leaves the field

159._why: Julia (Sunyshore; 1.0.1, v101-test): Black 2 has no word picker, so ChooseCustomMessageWord (0x243) is a stub and the 'no word chosen' test after it read what RTCGetWeekDay had left in VAR_0x800C: the weekday, 0 on Sunday, so Sunday never gave the Smile Ribbon (Monday to Saturday gave theirs). Each day's test compares with 0xFFFF instead, so every day goes on to its ribbon, as a chosen word would.

0x1c7.why: Sunday: never 'no word' (the stub chose none)

0x21b.why: Monday: never 'no word' (the stub chose none)

0x26f.why: Tuesday: never 'no word' (the stub chose none)

0x2c3.why: Wednesday: never 'no word' (the stub chose none)

0x317.why: Thursday: never 'no word' (the stub chose none)

0x36b.why: Friday: never 'no word' (the stub chose none)

0x3bf.why: Saturday: never 'no word' (the stub chose none)
